executor_id_note: O manifesto desta rodada nao informa o ID de um executor unico do checker/renderer.
scope: Revisao independente do checker/renderer de coordenacao, nao revisao cientifica ou empirica.

checks.result: PASS: 9 gates, 40 todos; structural checks only

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY' (import checker; compare render(read_json(LEDGER)) with RENDERED text) PY
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY' (copy ledger in memory; create synthetic files with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/tmp'); call validate and render or CLI subprocess) PY
checks.result: Eight counterexamples recorded in findings; no candidate edits

findings.counterexample: G0 and G1 pass share G0-only review/adjudication (both JSON contain gate_id=G0), same manifest and todo evidence; validate(plan,tmp_root) == [].
findings.effect: Approval of G0 can be reused to release G1 without gate-specific review.
findings.repair: Bind manifest, review and adjudication to gate and round; check consistency and gate-specific evidence.

findings.counterexample: G0 pass with executor_id='agent' and reviewer_id='agent ' in records and review; validate(plan,tmp_root) == [].
findings.effect: Textual aliases for one agent satisfy the distinct-reviewer check.
findings.repair: Require canonical agent IDs and verify against dispatch; normalize/type-check before comparison.

findings.counterexample: All nine gates pass with one manifested note.txt containing 'not official TSE data'; G8 external_evidence=['note.txt']; validate(plan,tmp_root) == [].
findings.effect: G8 can structurally pass without official election publication or coverage evidence.
findings.repair: Require typed official-source/turn/coverage evidence or explicit independently checked attestation.

findings.counterexample: G0 pass manifest lists note.txt only; analysis.py exists and changes from model=1 to model=2; validate remains [].
findings.effect: Changes to omitted but used code do not invalidate approval.
findings.repair: Check manifest completeness against gate deliverables, run inputs and outputs before pass.

findings.counterexample: After valid G0 pass, rewrite review.json to add unresolved critical C-RED while retaining status=pass; old adjudication unresolved_material_findings=0; validate remains [].
findings.effect: Review changes after adjudication do not invalidate prior approval.
findings.repair: Bind adjudication to review digest and reconcile finding IDs/classifications.

findings.counterexample: CLI check --ledger /tmp/case.json exits 0 for missing date, routing=[], or G0.write_scope=[42]; CLI render --ledger /tmp/case.json --output /tmp/case.md exits 1 with KeyError, AttributeError, or TypeError respectively.
findings.effect: A ledger accepted by check can break plan regeneration during update.
findings.repair: Validate all renderer fields and types before PASS or output write.

findings.counterexample: CLI check --ledger /tmp/case.json with G0.status=[] or G0-T1.evidence[0].basis=[] exits 1 with TypeError traceback and no FAIL diagnostic.
findings.effect: Malformed ledger updates produce uncontrolled errors instead of actionable validation messages.
findings.repair: Check primitive types before set membership and handle schema errors in main.

findings.counterexample: G0.title='Title"]\n    G8 --> G0\n    x["extra' passes validate; render emits a fake G8 --> G0 Mermaid edge.
findings.effect: Generated dependency diagram can contradict the validated graph.
findings.repair: Escape or reject Mermaid control characters in labels.

limits: Synthetic /tmp fixtures show checker behavior, not real gate approval.
No R, MCMC, installation, electoral-data validation, or mathematical review was performed.
Renderer equality was textual; no visual QA of Markdown was performed.
The contract explicitly limits the checker to structural validation; coordinator adjudication remains necessary.
